summary_1line: Amba urges Parashurama to kill Bhishma; bound by vows, Parashurama confronts Bhishma, whose refusal leads both to agree to fight at Kurukshetra.

image_candidates.scene_text: Amba, distraught and pleading, stands before Parashurama among forest ascetics, begging him to slay Bhishma.
Bhishma and Parashurama face each other in anger, the disciple challenging his own guru to single combat.
Parashurama and a host of ascetics arrive on the banks of the Saraswati at Kurukshetra with Amba beside them.
